## From complex biological data to traceable therapeutic hypotheses

I am a computational biologist working at the intersection of immuno-oncology, single-cell and spatial genomics, biomarker discovery, and explainable AI-assisted research.

My work focuses on a simple principle: computational predictions are most useful when the evidence behind them remains visible, testable, and biologically interpretable.

[Explore my projects](projects.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Read the blog](blog.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## Featured project

::: {.project-card}
### TargetIntel-IO

An explainable, therapeutic-intent-aware framework for triaging candidate targets in anti-PD-1-resistant melanoma.

Instead of producing one universal ranking, TargetIntel-IO separates different translational questions: combination targets, resistance biomarkers, tumor-intrinsic drivers, and poor direct therapeutic targets.

[Project overview](projects/targetintel-io.qmd) · [GitHub repository](https://github.com/rsolerortuno/TargetIntel-IO)
:::
